raw_response:
I farm only 5.5 mu, and some people in my family work off-farm, so I will keep my plan practical, familiar, and not too labor-heavy. I have done wheat-maize for many years in Quzhou County, and with well irrigation I will stay with the same system because it is reliable for me. I will split the full 5.5 mu into winter wheat followed by summer maize on the same land. For wheat, I will use improved seed, put enough nitrogen first and then topdress once, and give a few irrigations because wheat here responds well when water is available. For summer maize, I will use hybrid seed because I want stable ears and better yield, with moderate fertilizer and fewer irrigations since summer rain helps. I will use rotary tillage because it fits my scale, saves effort, and is easy to arrange. I will control pests only as needed, not excessively, because I want to control cost while protecting yield.
